tasks.label: Build faster-blaster DLL
tasks.command: cd 'c:\Users\cires\OneDrive\Documents\projects\faster-blaster\build-clang' && ninja faster-blaster 2>&1 | Select-String 'error:|FAILED' | Select-Object -First 20; echo DONE:$LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Run failing ctest tests
tasks.command: cd 'c:\Users\cires\OneDrive\Documents\projects\faster-blaster\build-clang'; ctest -C Release -R 'device_api|comprehensive' --output-on-failure 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 30; echo DONE:$LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Run BLIS test check exit code
Build DLL and BLIS test
tasks.command: cd 'c:\Users\cires\OneDrive\Documents\projects\faster-blaster\build-clang' && ninja faster-blaster test_blis_backend 2>&1 | Select-String 'error:|FAILED|BUILD' | Select-Object -First 10; echo DONE:$LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Reconfigure cmake for BLIS disabled
tasks.command: cd 'c:\Users\cires\OneDrive\Documents\projects\faster-blaster\build-clang'; cmake .. -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release 2>&1 | Select-String 'error:|BLIS' | Select-Object -First 5; echo CMAKE:$LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Run BLIS Test
tasks.command: cd 'c:\Users\cires\OneDrive\Documents\projects\faster-blaster\build-clang' && ninja test_blis_backend && echo BUILD_OK && cd tests && .\test_blis_backend.exe; echo EXIT:$LASTEXITCODE
